name: Isolated HV voltage sensing with delta-sigma modulator and MCU SDFM
function: Divides a 500 V bus to the ±1 V input of an isolated delta-sigma modulator; the bitstream is decimated by the MCU's sigma-delta filter module with a PWM-generated clock.

inputs.name: CLK_MOD
inputs.description: modulator clock from a spare MCU PWM

outputs.name: DOUT
outputs.description: single-bit stream to MCU SDFM input

operating_conditions: Full scale 500 V -> 0.756 V (75.6 % of 1 V).

required_components.role: input, clock and data RC/series elements
required_components.value_or_part: small series resistors (40.2 ohm, 100 ohm) and pF-range capacitors per Figure 3-3

interface_requirements: MCU with sigma-delta filter peripheral; clock propagation delay compensated (TI uses a delayed clock fed back to SDFM inputs, Table 4-1).
pcb_constraints: Clock and data routed as short, series-terminated digital lines.
Divider in the HV creepage region.
validation_notes: Divider scaling recomputed (EC-016). Digital filter configuration was not analysed.
limitations: Battery-sense divider ratio depends on relay state (§3.2.2.1); both states need analysis.
